name: school-schedule-generator-monorepo
description: Full-stack School Schedule Generator Monorepo (Engine, Client, Server)

scripts.dev:all: concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "ENGINE,SERVER,CLIENT" -c "yellow,blue,green" "pnpm --filter school-timetabling-engine watch" "pnpm --filter server dev" "pnpm --filter client dev"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter school-timetabling-engine build && pnpm --filter client build
